title: RocketJump's Nail House: How Freddie Wong Launched The Biggest Crowdfunded Action Movie of All Time
summary: Discover how Freddie Wong's Nail House became the #1 crowdfunded action film of all time, raising over $1M on BackerKit by leveraging its Patreon community. Learn the strategies behind RocketJump's biggest success.
body_markdown:
> *“ **BackerKit helped me maximize my Patreon following, boost revenue, deepen fan connections, and streamline all my crowdfunding efforts.** BackerKit let me tap into the smartest people alive: Dungeons and Daddies Patreon supporters and reward these remarkably brilliant individuals with perks on our crowdfund campaign. - Freddie Wong, Co-founder of RocketJump and Dungeons & Daddies, #7 Patreon Podcast Creator*


RocketJump’s[Nail House](https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/rocketjump/nail-house?ref=blog.backerkit.com) project led by legendary digital content creator Freddie Wong ([RocketJump](https://rocketjump.com/?ref=blog.backerkit.com) ,[Dungeons & Daddies](https://www.dungeonsanddaddies.com/?ref=blog.backerkit.com) , and[Video Game High School](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLsMtUWKCmBPRFzqglpk4YQlNFy8wzSXBN&ref=blog.backerkit.com) ) didn’t just meet its goal—it shattered expectations, becoming RocketJump’s most successful crowdfunding campaign ever and raising an astounding **$1,037,447** from **10,621 backers** on BackerKit Crowdfunding.


This massive win is significant for several key reasons, demonstrating BackerKit’s power to deliver extraordinary results, even under tight constraints. Here are some highlights:


### RocketJump’s Biggest Project Ever


RocketJump, a crowdfunding veteran, utilized their established Patreon community on BackerKit Crowdfunding for Nail House, allowing them to surpass their previous funding records on Kickstarter and Indiegogo.


The *Nail House* campaign achieved unprecedented success, becoming the **#1 RocketJump project of all time** by raising their first $1 million. This figure surpassed their previous record-breaking campaigns on other platforms. The campaign also set several new benchmarks in its genre, including:


- **#1 Biggest Crowdfunded Film of 2025**
- **#1 Crowdfunded Action Film of all time, across all platforms**
- **#1 Biggest Crowdfunded Feature Film of the past 3 years**


### Pioneering the Patreon Integration


By utilizing the[BackerKit Patreon integration](https://blog.backerkit.com/backerkit-launches-new-patreon-integration-to-unlock-crowdfunding-revenue-for-patreon-creators/) , RocketJump effectively transformed their existing subscriber base into enthusiastic project backers. They achieved this by introducing **exclusive tiers and special perks** as rewards, which helped **deepen their connection** with fans.


The ease of conversion for patrons helped **boost revenue** and drove the campaign to shatter expectations, becoming RocketJump’s most successful crowdfunding campaign and raising over **$1 million** . The case demonstrates that creators with an existing, engaged Patreon community are **positioned for success** to launch a record-breaking crowdfunding campaign on BackerKit.


### Marketing That Drove a Quarter Million


Initially, the RocketJump team estimated a raise of $300k–$500k. The final total more than doubled their highest projection—a true rocket jump!


Despite a short, two-week lead time, RocketJump’s strategy leveraged the Patreon integration, BackerKit Performance Marketing, community focus, and marketing agency partnership for explosive growth:


**BackerKit Performance Marketing**


BackerKit's performance marketing efforts helped drive over **$250,000** in pledges. Leads converted at an impressive **~25%** . The BackerKit Performance Marketing team was able to successfully experiment with a range of channels, including Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, and specific lead generation tactics, proving that strong results are possible for Film and Video projects through agile, multi-channel execution.


**Community Engagement and Activation**


The team successfully re-engaged their core fanbase, including patrons, through **strategic content** releases and interactive livestreams on BackerKit. A key tactic was the continuous **Overtime Mode Livestream** until the funding train ended. A **Q&A livestream** with the *Nail House* team, held during the final 72-hour push, proved to be a crucial piece of content. This event ran until the $1 Million goal was reached and successfully activated a previously dormant segment of the fanbase.


**Working with a Partner**


For a busy creator, you may occasionally need extra support. Another key element of Nail House's success was its strong partnership with[Vala Marketing](https://valamarketing.com/?ref=blog.backerkit.com) . Even with a demanding timeline, this marketing agency, specializing in services like crowdfunding management and strategy, rapidly created a highly effective, tailored strategy for Nail House. Their support spanned product development, content marketing, graphic design, and community moderation, among other services.
